What is being evaluated: Demonstrates a clear understanding of the role, responsibilities, and scope of a Student Champion.
Reflects respect for student needs, individuality, voice, and context.
Demonstrates awareness of confidentiality, boundaries, and limitations of the SC role.
Shows how the SC will support students while encouraging independence, responsibility, and ownership.
Outlines appropriate communication practices and awareness of when to collaborate or refer.
Presents clear, realistic, and actionable principles that reflect the individual's intended way of working with students.
The working agreement is clearly structured, thoughtful, and communicates the individual's practice principles effectively.
